payload.title: TI brand pack
payload.description:
Express TI's palette (light and dark), fonts from the allow-list, wordmark and logo as a brand pack (from publication/brand.ts, theme.css and redesign/theme-tokens.css).
Scenario: The brand pack alone gives TI its look
  Given the pack and the core preset
  When the site builds in light and dark
  Then colours, fonts and logo are TI's and the platform checks pass

Depends on: PPY-88a883, PPY-f06abd.
